title: High Availability & Disaster Recovery
description: Learn HA architectures, multi-AZ/multi-region patterns, RTO/RPO, and DR strategies like pilot light and warm standby.
longDescription: This module covers high availability and disaster recovery on AWS. You will learn how to design multi-AZ and multi-region architectures, implement auto scaling and load balancing, choose the right DR strategy, and plan RTO and RPO for business continuity.
whatYouLearn: Implement auto scaling and load balancing for HA
Plan RTO and RPO for business continuity
